data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'miras', meaning 'wonderful' or 'admirable'. The suffix '-illa' is a diminutive, meaning 'little' or 'dear'. This name is often given to a child who is born during a peaceful and prosperous time, and is considered a symbol of hope and happiness. The name Mirilla carries the meaning “Peaceful little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mirilla usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
